messages:
Anya (People Ops): Hey all — Jordan just pinged that their consulate appointment for visa stamping got canceled. Jordan, can you share what the consulate said?
Jordan R.: They said my DS-160 had a small last-name spelling mismatch. Refund + cancel, rebooked for 2025-03-12. I got the email this morning.
Sasha L. (Hiring Manager): Ugh. We have a client go-live 2025-04-01. Can we still get Jordan onboarded before that if stamping slips?
Mike H. (People Ops): Quick checklist: 1) we need the cancellation email and new appointment confirmation; 2) decide payroll/start contingency; 3) benefits enrollment impact; 4) travel letter for consulate. Jordan, can you upload the emails to the onboarding folder?
Jordan R.: Uploading now — here’s the booking ref: UK987654. No attachments in Slack but I pasted screenshot to the folder.
Anya (People Ops): Thanks. Initial plan options: A) delay official start until visa stamped (we issue an offer amendment with a revised start date) B) start as a contractor (not preferred) C) have the team cover the gap. We should quantify cost and benefits impact.
Sasha L. (Hiring Manager): We can extend contractor coverage until 3/31 if needed. Not ideal long-term but OK for the go-live. Is there any chance of expedited stamping?
ImmigrationBot: FYI: Consulate cancellations for DS-160 mismatches require a new DS-160 and a new appointment. Most consulates do not offer premium processing for consular stamping — times vary by location. Dropbox eligibility may apply; check consulate FAQ: https://travel.state.gov
Mike H. (People Ops): Legal, do we have a standard contingency clause for start-date changes due to stamping delays? @Legal - HR can you weigh in?
Legal - HR: We have a short amendment template that makes start contingent on valid work authorization. Wording: "Start date is contingent upon employee obtaining necessary visa/stamping; employer may delay start without penalty until authorization is confirmed." I can paste the snippet if useful.
Jordan R.: The rebooked slot is 3/12 but consulate warned it could take up to 10 business days for return. That pushes potential start into late March.
Anya (People Ops): OK — Mike, can you draft an offer amendment proposing a revised tentative start of 2025-03-24 with a contingency clause and a note about benefits/prorate?
Mike H. (People Ops): Will do. Also flagging benefits: if start shifts beyond 30 days from offer acceptance, open enrollment window may be affected. I'll loop Benefits to confirm exact cutoff.
Sasha L. (Hiring Manager): If we can't bring Jordan by 3/24, team will continue contractor coverage through 3/31. I'll budget for that.
ImmigrationBot: Additional note: travel letter should state reason for travel, role, employer contact, and tentative start date. Consulates sometimes ask for employer confirmation of return intent.
Anya (People Ops): Drafting travel letter now. Template snippet: ```To whom it may concern: This letter confirms that Jordan R. is currently employed as (prospective position) with Redwood Inference and is requesting visa stamping to enable start on the agreed date. Employer contact: Mike H., people ops.```
Jordan R.: Thanks — that helps. Do we need to provide proof of benefits enrollment?
Anya (People Ops): Not usually for stamping, but Benefits team may need the final start date to confirm eligibility window. I'll copy Benefits and Payroll once amendment is ready.
Mike H. (People Ops): Drafted amendment and sent to Legal for quick review. Will post the doc in the onboarding folder and ping everyone.
Legal - HR: Reviewed, minor tweak to contingency sentence. Approved.
Anya (People Ops): Mike — after you send the amendment, please mark payroll hold so no pay is issued before active start. Also set a reminder to re-open benefits enrollment when start is confirmed.
Mike H. (People Ops): Done. Payroll hold set as tentative; amendment uploaded to Notion: https://notion.redwood/workforce/onboarding/jordan-r — pinged Benefits.
Sasha L. (Hiring Manager): Appreciate the quick coordination. Jordan — keep us updated on the consulate tracking number and passport return. :thumbsup:
Jordan R.: Will do. Thanks everyone for moving fast.
Anya (People Ops): Closing loop here: created task for travel letter, amendment uploaded, payroll hold set, Benefits notified. Will re-open thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
